name: Ad Caelum Draconis
source:
KA72Y is a state-owned infantry thrall of the Lamian Empire. Following the conquest of another planet to join the ever-expanding Empire, KA72Y is out of work and sent to Garuna, a notorious entertainment hub.

But peacetime is far from relaxing, and KA72Y is soon involved in the underside of the galaxy’s hottest tourist destination.

[From [url=https://akagekurage.itch.io/caelum-draconis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
KA72Y是拉米安帝国的国有步兵奴隶。在征服另一个星球并加入不断扩张的帝国后，KA72Y失业并被送往臭名昭著的娱乐中心加鲁纳。

但和平时期远非轻松，KA72Y很快就卷入了银河系最热门旅游目的地的地下世界。

[来自[url=https://akagekurage.itch.io/caelum-draconis]itch.io[/url]]
